channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A coastal storm will bring rain and strong wind gusts to Vermont late tonight. A Wind Advisory is in effect for Addison, Windham, Rutland, and Bennington counties. Gusts could reach up to sixty miles per hour on mountain slopes, causing possible power outages.

The Canadian Pacific Holiday Train is rolling north along Lake Champlain this afternoon. Now in its twenty-eighth year, the brightly lit Holiday Train will stop in Fort Edward around three. It arrives at the Port Henry Amtrak Station around six tonight before continuing north to Plattsburgh around eight. Organizers encourage attendees to bring non-perishable food items or cash donations to support local food banks and pantries.

Efficiency Vermont is helping residents seal up their homes as temperatures drop. They offer rebates and low-interest loans for weatherization projects. Older homes, which make up about a quarter of Vermont's housing, especially benefit from these improvements.

New York Governor Kathy Hochul delayed Medicaid work requirements until June next year. The rules require recipients to show eighty hours a month of work or education, with some exemptions. The state is upgrading systems and hopes for federal changes to ease these rules.
